question: Who was the prominent leader during the Quit India Movement, remembered for hoisting the Indian flag at the Gowalia Tank Maidan in Mumbai in 1942?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Aruna Asaf Ali**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__

• **Aruna Asaf Ali** was a prominent leader during the **Quit India Movement**, which began on **8 August 1942**, under the leadership of Mahatma Gandhi.

• She is famously remembered for **hoisting the Indian National Flag** at the **Gowalia Tank Maidan** in Mumbai, defying British authorities and marking the commencement of the movement.

• The act of flag hoisting made her a symbol of resistance and courage, earning her the title of the **"Heroine of the 1942 Quit India Movement."**

• Despite the British crackdown and arrests of key leaders, including Mahatma Gandhi, Aruna Asaf Ali continued to inspire people and mobilize support for India's independence.

• She played an instrumental role in organizing underground activities and publishing revolutionary literature, including the **Congress Radio**, which broadcasted news and messages to keep the freedom struggle alive.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__

• **Quit India Movement:** 

• Launched by Mahatma Gandhi during the **Bombay session** of the Indian National Congress on **8 August 1942**.

• The movement called for the immediate withdrawal of British rule from India, with the slogan **"Do or Die."**

• It was a mass civil disobedience movement, involving strikes, protests, and boycotts across the country.

• The British responded with severe repression, including arrests, violence, and the disruption of communication channels.

• **Gowalia Tank Maidan:** 

• Renamed as **August Kranti Maidan**, it holds historical significance as the venue where the Quit India Movement was launched.

• The flag hoisting by Aruna Asaf Ali at this location became a symbolic act of defiance against colonial rule.

• **Aruna Asaf Ali’s Contribution:** 

• She was a staunch advocate for India's independence and actively participated in various movements, including the **Salt March** and **Quit India Movement**.

• She served as a member of the Indian National Congress and later joined the **Socialist Party** and **Communist Party of India**.

• Post-independence, she continued her activism, focusing on social welfare and education reforms.

• **Legacy:** 

• She was awarded the **Bharat Ratna** posthumously in **1997**, recognizing her contributions to India's freedom struggle.

• Her courage and determination make her a celebrated figure in Indian history and a role model for women in leadership.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

• **Sucheta Kriplani:** 

• She was the first woman Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh and a prominent freedom fighter.

• She played an active role in the Quit India Movement but is not associated with the flag hoisting at Gowalia Tank.

• **Annie Besant:** 

• A British socialist, theosophist, and supporter of Indian self-rule, she contributed to India's freedom struggle but was not directly involved in the Quit India Movement.

• **Vijayalakshmi Pandit:** 

• The sister of Jawaharlal Nehru, she was an important political leader and diplomat but did not participate in the flag hoisting at Gowalia Tank.
